description: This file is a shell script designed to test various aspects of 'git reflog' display routines. It contains test cases that verify the formatting, output, and behavior of 'git reflog' commands with different options and date formats.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting successful execution

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances the test clock to simulate time passing

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares expected and actual output to verify correctness

methods.name: test_must_be_empty
methods.description: Verifies that the output is empty

methods.name: test_commit
methods.description: Creates a new commit for testing
